title: Operating a Volunteer OpenSky Node in Brazil: Field Notes on Coverage, Uptime, and Local Regulations
description:
Local ADS-B field observations through 30 September 2026. Adds Era B, the paired antenna comparison, aggregated coverage/uptime/propagation results, source scripts and the A0 symposium poster. Raw traces and aircraft-index caches are not included. The revised short paper will follow this data release.

Only direct ADS-B sources adsb_icao and adsb_icao_nt; MLAT excluded; receiver rounded to (-20.51, -47.40). Era A: 5,153,167 positions over 32 days. Era B: 36,535,422 positions over 137 elapsed days. Common fleet: 2,234 aircraft, pooled mean range +15.6%. One local node, not a network-wide coverage claim. The last 33 days lack a source checksum.
